prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted), whereas moving sign-in before final launch showed no clear effect.
Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), while static time estimates, safeguards, checklists, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Adoption step redesigns significantly hurt performance (-27.5% measured), while adoption layout changes showed no clear effect and had overly optimistic predictions.
Finish screen additions (control guides, notification prompts, badges, and incentives) showed no clear effect, and positive predictions were set too high.
Path selection copy and layout adjustments showed no clear effect, with predictions over-estimating impact.
Sign-in helper hints and safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions set too high.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -15.0% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- finish, incentive: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.3% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.6% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.2%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Quick Path Direct Selection Card: Insert a new decision screen right before path selection that presents a clear visual choice card for quick onboarding. (why: choose_path step takes a mean time of 514s and drops off 23.8% of users due to initial hesitation.)
1: [home, wait_info] Live Audio Visual Waiting Ambiance: Add ambient pet sound feedback and animation to the waiting screen while creation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time (2336s); past live visualizers worked very well (+9.3%).)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Mascot Audio Welcome Screen: Redesign the home_intro screen to play a subtle audio greeting mascot asset confirming the pet is active. (why: Support noted 3 issues where pets did not appear visible on desktop, contributing to a 35.2% dropoff at finish.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Quality Sound Tip: Add a subtle tip carousel on the upload_photos screen explaining optimal lighting for pet generation. (why: 3 support tickets cited failed or misaligned custom pet generation, and adoption has a 39.1% drop-off rate.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Certificate Sound Effect Confirmation: Play a celebratory adoption sound effect when reaching the adoption certificate step. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and longest active interaction time.)
5: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Status Progress Tracker: Enable the step counter and progress indicator on the sign_in screen to show completion status. (why: Sign-in step has a mean duration of 567s; displaying visual progress keeps users motivated to finish.)
6: [home, layout] Waiting Screen Spotlight View: Change the layout of the waiting screen to 'spotlight' to highlight the active progress indicator. (why: Mean time spent waiting is 2336s; spotlighting status progress keeps users aware of background loading.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Launch Callout: Update copy on home_intro to explicitly direct users to check their system taskbar tray icon. (why: Support reported confusion on how to open, control, or reveal the pet after onboarding completes.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen adds friction; path selection tweaks historically showed no clear benefit.
Live visual and progress elements on the waiting screen previously far exceeded predictions.
Strong evidence from support and funnel, but full redesigns at finish consistently hurt conversion.
Addresses the lowest-converting step with support validation, though hints yield modest lift.
High step dropoff, but sound incentives do not solve adoption friction and past incentives failed.
Cheap config change, but progress tracker/notification additions previously showed negative lift.
Layout adjustments historically yield minor to neutral impact compared to live progress elements.
Zero-code copy update directly solving a reported support issue on a high dropoff step.
